inputs.name: dockge_version
inputs.description: Tag of the Dockge image, such as "1.5.0". Change image_digest with it.

inputs.name: image_digest
inputs.description: Digest of the image for dockge_version, such as "sha256:335c...". Podman pulls by the digest, so a tag that moves upstream can't change what runs.

inputs.name: image_repository
inputs.description: Where to pull Dockge's image from, without a tag. Upstream publishes it on Docker Hub only.

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: Address Dockge listens on. The default keeps it on the host for a reverse proxy in front; "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: stacks_dir
inputs.description: Directory holding a folder per stack, each with its compose.yaml. Dockge sees it at the same path.
